name: benchmark
description: A new benchmark and dataset built upon CaptainCook4D featuring densely annotated, timed instructions and feedback messages, including mistake alerts precisely timestamped to their visual occurrence in video. It evaluates multi-modal LLMs' ability to provide live, interactive step-by-step task guidance.
reputation: A very recent multimodal benchmark that is not yet widely adopted, but it addresses a practical interactive video-guidance setting.
notes: Focuses on real-time interactive guidance and mistake detection in multi-modal LLMs.
